relationships.subject: CREB knockdown in ACC

relationships.subject: Peripheral nerve injury
relationships.evidence_quote: c-fos and postsynaptic density-95 (PSD-95) expression were increased in the ipsilateral spinal cord and contralateral ACC

key_findings: CREB/BDNF is activated in spinal cord and ACC after SNI; ACC CREB knockdown or peripheral 666-15 relieves pain and anxiodepression.
